test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_source_capture_start.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/source_capture_start.py tests/test_source_capture_start.py

implemented: Captures a unique source session ID and verifies capture start precedes the earliest decision time.
Persists the capture-start marker before the first market event, with monotonic immutable replay semantics.
Records measured clock skew, clock evidence ID, initial quote-health facts/reasons, and source entitlement evidence with validity windows.
Missing or expired source entitlements are visible and block the capture receipt's entry-eligibility indicator.
blockers: Live Kite capture startup is not wired to invoke the receipt API.
Clock and entitlement evidence is supplied by callers and is not independently authenticated.
No actual observed source-capture session has been produced.
